csv_project_name: DB for Dulles Fleet Maintenance Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) has established a contracting opportunity to enhance Heavy Repair and Overhaul (HRO) capabilities at its Dulles Rail Yard . The Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) Fleet Maintenance Facility is a Best Value Design-Build project with the goal of enhancing Heavy Repair and Overhaul (HRO) capabilities at its Dulles Rail Yard located at 44357 Old Ox Road, Sterling, Virginia 20166. A summary of the scope of work includes expanding the existing Service and Inspection Building to create additional repair bays and workspaces; conversion of the existing 40,000-square-foot warehouse into industrial shop space; add a 6th track at the existing maintenance building and two turnouts to connect the new track to the remainder of the yard. Furnish and install specialized equipment.
